class.name: StaticLayer
class.description: Reads a static OccupancyGrid map from a topic and writes it into the master costmap.

class.name: ObstacleLayer
class.description: Marks and clears obstacles from laser/pointcloud sensor data.

class.name: InflationLayer
class.description: Inflates obstacle costs outward by a configurable radius.

class.name: KeepoutFilter
class.description: Applies a binary keepout mask from an OccupancyGrid onto the costmap.

class.name: SpeedFilter
class.description: Limits robot speed based on a speed-restriction mask.
